title: Vitess: failover-test (VTOrc auto-reparent on primary kill)
description: The future nexus-cli VitessAdapter `failover-test` verb -- records shard -80's current PRIMARY, stops its vttablet+mysqld, waits for VTOrc to promote a replica (auto-reparent), verifies the keyspace stays writable via vtgate, then restarts the killed tablet and confirms it rejoins as REPLICA. DESTRUCTIVE: requires --yes.

observe.what: old primary nexus-100 -> killed; VTOrc promotes nexus-101/102; 'cluster writable' INSERT via vtgate succeeds; killed tablet restarted -> 'rejoined REPLICA'; back to 1P+2R
VTOrc UI logs the RecoverDeadPrimary analysis + the chosen new primary
sudo /usr/local/sbin/nexus-vtctldclient GetTablets --keyspace commerce --shard -80 shows the new PRIMARY

whatProves: VTOrc performs unattended reparent on PRIMARY loss with semi_sync durability (no acked write lost); vtgate re-routes transparently; the killed tablet self-heals back to REPLICA. The HA guarantee of the relational sharding tier.
